description: Source code implementing quantized linear operations using oneDNN for XPU in PyTorch, including functions for deciding output data types, performing pointwise and binary quantized matrix multiplications, and registering these implementations with the PyTorch library.

classes.name: QLinearOnednnXPU
classes.description: Class implementing quantized linear operations using oneDNN for XPU in PyTorch.

methods.name: qlinear_decide_out_dtype
methods.description: Decides the output data type for quantized linear operations based on input tensor and optional output dtype.

methods.description: Performs quantized pointwise linear operation with given input tensor, scales, zero points, bias, and post-processing options.
